beats.11: Recover the head toward its exact original angle and smile in the baseline, 80 percent back; free hand still down. Leave a small difference for the final in-between.

beats.08: Hold the friendly greeting with head tilted 6 degrees toward screen-right, soft smiling eyes and a lively small smile. Terminal stays steady, free arm relaxed.

beats.02: Anticipation: eyes look down at terminal. Free screen-right elbow starts bending, hand lifts from thigh toward lower ribs, index finger beginning to extend. Screen-left hand always supports terminal.
beats.05: Contact: free screen-right forearm reaches across the chest from its same screen-right shoulder; its index fingertip gently touches the lower viewer-right region of the terminal screen. Eyes follow finger. Supporting screen-left hand remains under device; no other hand supports it.
beats.08: Recoil: index retracts 6 centimetres from screen, forearm starting to withdraw along the same arc; head still watches terminal, wrist relaxed. No second supporting hand.

beats.11: Recovery: terminal and right supporting forearm 85 percent back to baseline, free screen-right hand lowers almost to thigh, expression settles to original smile.
beats.02: Anticipation: free screen-right elbow bends slightly, hand turns palm-up at waist, head tilts toward the terminal; supported terminal draws inward just 2 centimetres.
beats.05: Presentation apex: screen-left forearm extends the terminal forward a restrained 6 centimetres and tips the display 8 degrees toward viewer; screen-right free hand opens palm-up beside waist as an invitation; face smiles toward viewer. beats.08: Hold presentation with a tiny welcoming head nod, palm-up free hand relaxing its fingers; device still stably supported. Same camera and feet.
